name: [🌋 EVIL WORLD!] Shopping Cart Simulator!
desc:
🤑 BOOSTED COINS AND LUCK EVENT! 🍀

🛒 Welcome to Shopping Cart Simulator! 🛒
SCS is a NEW simulator game where you launch yourself into another dimension within a... Shopping Cart???

❓ HOW TO PLAY ❓
🚀 Launch your Shopping Cart off a Ramp to try and get further than everyone else! 
🏁 When Launching, make sure you hop into your Cart when your Cart is directly over the Neon Checkpoints! 
💰 Perform Tricks, buy Friends or use your Coffee to boost your Style Points which will give you more Coins! 
🛹 Perform Tricks on Mobile by tapping and holding down your screen! On Console, press and hold the B button!
💯 Unlock a TON of Upgrades to make your Cart go faster, like Rockets or better Wheels! 
🗺️ Reach the end of each map to unlock different Worlds!

👍 Thumbs up, Favorite, and Follow for WEEKLY updates!
🌐 Join the Halt Studios group for Daily Coin Rewards!

⭐NEXT OP CODE AT 10K LIKES👍
